candidate_relations.reason: Lichen planus does not identify the acral necrolytic eruption supported by the symmetric dorsal-foot plaques and necrolytic histopathology.
Hypertrophic lichen planus may produce pruritic hyperkeratotic plaques but is not necrolytic acral erythema and does not match the characteristic acral distribution and necrolytic changes.
Zinc deficiency can be associated with necrolytic acral erythema, but the plasma zinc level is within the stated reference range and this label does not name the skin disorder.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Possible metabolic association rather than the cutaneous diagnosis

candidate_relations.reason: Plaque psoriasis does not represent necrolytic acral erythema despite overlapping plaque morphology and scale.
Psoriasis is a separate diagnostic entity and does not capture the acral necrolytic eruption shown clinically and histologically.
“坏死松解性肢端红斑” is the Chinese term for necrolytic acral erythema.
